results.criterion: The hours section lists Monday to Friday 8am to 10pm and Saturday and Sunday 9am to 11pm, and JavaScript highlights today's row automatically from the visitor's current day.
results.note: Seven rows with the correct times; script matches new Date().getDay() to data-day and adds bl-today; js_errors is empty. The highlight was not observed in a browser, only read in the code.

results.criterion: The menu shows every item with a ₹ price: Coffee: Espresso 120, Cappuccino 180, Pour-over 220; Cold: Cold brew 200; Food: Croissant 150, Banana bread 130.
results.note: Menu markup lists Espresso ₹120, Cappuccino ₹180, Pour-over ₹220, Cold brew ₹200, Croissant ₹150, Banana bread ₹130 under Coffee, Cold and Food.

results.criterion: The pre-order form lists the same six items with quantity inputs and shows a running total in ₹ that updates as quantities change.
results.note: Six number inputs with data-price matching the menu; the input and change listeners call update(), which writes '₹'+total to the output element.

results.criterion: Submitting the pre-order form opens a WhatsApp message to +91 98450 00000 containing the chosen items and the total, and the page states pay at pickup and pickup within 15 minutes of ordering.
results.note: PHONE='919845000000'; the submit handler builds a wa.me URL with the items, total and name; the page shows 'Pay at pickup.' and 'Pickup within 15 minutes of ordering.'; the mechanical form submit ran with no errors.

results.criterion: The loyalty section shows 10 stamp circles, with the 10th circle marked FREE.
results.note: The ol has 10 li.bl-stamp elements; the 10th has class bl-stamp-free and the text FREE; the border-radius is 50%.

results.criterion: The location section shows the address 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038 and a "Get directions" link to https://maps.google.com/?q=100+Feet+Road+Indiranagar+Bengaluru+560038.
results.note: The address element reads '100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038'; the link labelled 'Get directions' has href https://maps.google.com/?q=100+Feet+Road+Indiranagar+Bengaluru+560038.

results.criterion: At 360px and 1280px wide the page has no horizontal overflow, and loading and using the page throws no JavaScript errors.
results.note: Mechanical check: phone overflow_px 0, desktop overflow_px 0, js_errors [], form submit ok with no errors, broken_in_page_links [].

extra_issues.note: The head contains two <title> tags and two <meta charset> tags (the shell stub plus the W-1 head block); browsers use the first title, 'Brew Lab'.
